title: Retired unprefixed hex key in a configuration line
summary: A 32-character hex string appears under EXAMPLECLOUD_KEY; that was the format before 2024-07-01.
rationale: Old keys may persist in old files, but the format is indistinguishable from any other hex string, so the evidence does not support a firm expectation either way.

expectation.rationale: The retired format is documented, but whether such keys are still accepted is an open question, so a scanner may flag or not.

sources.supports: Documents the retired unprefixed hex format.
